beats: One of the four boys slipped out, and the family TV still thought he was home.
It trusted only the hallway camera, so the whole house stayed stuck on a boy who'd already left.
Now any boy taps his own name on the kiosk the moment he's gone.
A two-tap confirm guards against accidents, then Cloudflare Workers updates the house instantly.
The camera brings him back the instant it sees him again - home or away in just two taps.
